purpose: Character-only alpha extractions of the approved thirteen corrected CutinSmall previews.
alignment_note: Explicit top-of-silhouette anchors: center of the first 2.5 percent alpha-height band, alpha >= 16. Runtime uses one uniform scale; final placement is subject to built-content screenshot verification.

portraits.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent 2D game character sprite.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's approved corrected character illustration. Image 2 is ONLY a supporting reference for costume coverage below image 1's bottom crop. Extract only the single character from image 1 into a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG. Preserve image 1's exact face, expression, hair, outfit colors, corrected body proportions, arm assignments, hand gestures and viewing direction; do not revert to image 2's exaggerated anatomy. Remove the entire colored background, diagonal stained-glass strip, all lettering, external bloom and scenery. Clean alpha throughout gaps in hair, arms and clothing. Preserve character accessories. Keep all headwear and hands inside canvas. Continue only the clipped lower clothing/hair enough to match the body coverage in image 2 (same lower cutoff, no new feet or full-body invention). Use a portrait or near-square canvas fitting the isolated character naturally with small transparent margins. Do not stretch, mirror, add limbs, change pose, create a shadow or bake checkerboard into pixels. No redesign.
